Conclusion: The IndexError in the `test_empty` method of `tests.test_black.BlackTestCase` is caused by attempting to access an element at index `-1` in `src_contents`. This error occurs because the function `lib2to3_parse` checks if `src_contents` ends with a newline character (`"\n"`) before accessing its last element, but when `source` and `expected` are both empty strings, there is no newline character to check, leading to an out-of-range index.

Methods to fix this issue:

```
black.lib2to3.pgen2.driver.Driver.check_newline
```
